patthana20.3:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca no āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.3:2.1: na no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca no āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.3:3.1: na āsavañca na no āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.3:5.1: na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ca anāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti, hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.3:6.1: na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.3:11.1: na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.3:12.1: ekaṃ. hetuyā pañca. na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
patthana20.3:13.1: na āsavañceva na āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava. na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.3:15.1: sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
